s2_00: Top left of a menu picture: a rough dark brown wooden table with grain, a magazine cover lying at a slight angle on the left, and the left edge of a ruled spiral notepad at the right. The magazine cover is purple-grey with an illustrated airship being hit by an explosion, small propeller planes, a city seen from above and an orange aircraft in the foreground; at the bottom left of the cover is a small white skull and crossbones. On the cover is one round logo: a dark brown disc with an orange rim. Curved white capital letters along the top of the disc read 'AIR ACTION WEEKLY' (A-I-R, A-C-T-I-O-N, W-E-E-K-L-Y). Inside the disc, white thin script 'Air' on top; below it the big orange word 'SPICY!' in chunky letters S, P, I, C, Y and an exclamation mark, each with a yellow-green outline and a dark shadow; below that white thin script 'Tales'; and curved white capitals under the disc read 'PRESENTS' (P-R-E-S-E-N-T-S). The notepad part has paper with thin green ruled lines and black spiral rings at the top. No other lettering anywhere: no extra words, no numbers, no signature, no stamps, no new symbols.
s2_01: Top right of a menu picture: orange-brown wooden table with grain and dark knots, a ruled spiral notepad with a brown leather frame in the middle and right, and the right edge of a magazine cover at the left. The magazine cover part is cut by the left edge of the tile and shows only the right part of its round logo: a dark brown disc with an orange rim; white capitals along its top end with 'N WEEKLY' (the words before are cut off), then the right part of the big orange chunky letters 'ICY!' with yellow-green outline (the letters S and P are cut off), below it the white thin script ending in 'ales' and the curved white capitals ending in 'ENTS'. Below the logo are a purple-grey sky, an aerial city view and an orange aircraft. The notepad paper is cream with thin green ruled lines, brown stain marks and a few burnt edges on the right; black spiral rings along the top. In the top right corner of the paper is one small faded printed logo: a small round dark grey disc with an orange rim, the orange chunky word 'SPICY!' with yellow outline across it, thin white script above and below, and tiny curved letters around. It is tiny and soft, so keep it as soft and as small as in the reference, do not make it readable or bigger. The notepad paper has no other lettering and no writing, no numbers; no creases or scratches, only the stains and burnt edges that the reference has. No other lettering anywhere: no extra words, no numbers, no signature, no stamps, no new symbols.
